notice: Domain migration contract: the format of a project's gtt-domain that this Bootstrap expects, the structural changes each release declared, and what a migration may write. Data only. The scripts read it; they never infer it from README text.
never_write: an Epic's heading block (Goal, Scope, Out of Scope, Approved)
bump_when: a release changes the STRUCTURE of what gtt-domain must contain in a way a validator or a script reads: add a row to format_changes with that release. A release that changes nothing in the structure adds nothing and a project updated to it is never asked. A mechanical step for the change may be added to the migration; the judgment is the agent's, and so is asking the human before touching anything

format_changes.en: a Story carries `Implements` (the anchors of the design it builds) and `Done when` with executable evidence (a test file or `run: <command>`)
format_changes.es: una Story lleva `Implements` (las anclas del diseño que construye) y `Done when` con evidencia ejecutable (un archivo de test o `run: <comando>`)
